# Holistic Training

> A global professional training and certification provider offering CIPD, EAPA, GARP, and other industry-recognized credentials across 5 continents.

Holistic Training delivers accredited professional development and certification programs through a network of training centers in major cities worldwide. The platform specializes in HR, compliance, risk management, and business certifications from leading professional bodies.

## Key Topics

- CIPD
- EAPA
- GARP
- HRCI
- PMI
- NEBOSH
- IIA
- IIBA
- Professional Certifications
- HR Development
- Risk Management
- Compliance Training
- Location-Based Courses
- Certification Programs
- Professional Development
